description: Start AI visual comparison of a public page against a Figma frame, saved design or uploaded image. Supply reference, or both figmaFileKey and figmaNodeId. Captures at the design’s authored width. Optional measureSpacing adds supported element measurements and tolerances. Uses your scan allowance and returns a persistent job ID; results include individual differences and screenshot evidence. Does not create issues or provide a deterministic pixel-difference build gate.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

figmaFileKey.description: Figma file key; use with figmaNodeId instead of reference

measureSpacing.description: Include supported element measurements and layout tolerances

dataUrl.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF data URL, up to 10 MiB before base64 encoding

reference.description: Figma, saved design, or uploaded image reference

requestId.description: New UUID for this review; reuse after a lost response

name: compare_visual
